title: Run message
description: Body of a message on the SQS run queue. The control plane sends it; the worker receives it and loads everything else through the internal API (ADR 0001). Delivery is at least once, so the same run_id may arrive more than once. The control plane also sets the SQS message attribute `traceparent` (String, W3C Trace Context) to the run's trace; the worker continues that trace and sends `traceparent` on its calls (ADR 0022). It is not part of the body.

schema_version.description: Shape version of this message. Bump on any breaking change.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the run. For logs and traces; the worker trusts the internal API, not this field.
